name: Maksim Anisimov
source: A music lover, amateur photographer. He considers himself an observer in any society - calm, sociable and in favour of any good idea. He is always on the lookout for someone like himself among all the people around him, but is also often unintentionally drawn to various creative types. He is always trying to find someone who is like him, but often stops at random in his work to find creative people.
